description: DRAFT (TASK-0055): stage C3+C4 of the T12 calibration (spec v0.27 §8.2 p.4, #177); model JetSliceCalib. meta.protocol: Frozen values of the EARLIER stages go into the top-level 'params' of this manifest (a revision with a new manifest_hash, recorded in 'journal'); the series sweep only this stage's own keys, so the manifest stays valid after every freeze. Spec v0.27 §8.2 p.4; lab-cli.md 'Точки калибровки T12'.
